summary: Randolph County, WV tower built by 1925; sold and moved to Snowshoe Mountain ski resort in 1999, where it still stands. Original site listed gone; footings photographed in 2022.

facts.status_note: Moved in 1999 to Snowshoe Mountain ski resort (Pocahontas County), where it stands; the original Randolph County site is listed as gone.

access.note: The tower now stands on privately owned Snowshoe Mountain ski resort ground; check with the resort before visiting.

notes_for_editor: Four sources read: the FFLOS register page for the Randolph County site, the NHLR page for the Snowshoe tower, the Eastern US Lookouts Snowshoe page, and the FFA WV list. The 1999 sale is described two ways. The register says it was sold to Snowshoe Mountain, Inc.; the Eastern US Lookouts page says the Department of Natural Resources sold it for one dollar. The register does not name the seller, so the two are not in conflict. The 80-foot height is from the Eastern US Lookouts page only and may be overall height rather than cab-floor height, so facts.height_m is omitted. Nothing is known about the Randolph County site beyond the 2022 photo captions (site and footings) and the association's Tower Gone; no owner or access found. A newspaper account of the 1999 sale would help. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the NHLR Snowshoe page lists 'Built 1999' under Lookout Details, which differs from the FFLOS 'Built by 1925' for the original Randolph County tower; the story does not use NHLR's build date, so an editor should decide whether to note the difference. The story's 'The register' now refers only to the FFLOS register, and NHLR is named where it is cited.WebSearch was refused for this tower because the shared run budget was already spent, and websearch.py was not used to get around the limit. Re-search before publishing.
